senses.gloss:
रोष्, ट्, m. one who hurts or injures, an injurer;
one who irritates or enrages.
रोष् रोष्, रोष, &c. See p. 851, col. 1.

रोष, अस्, m. anger, rage, wrath, passion, fury.
—रोष-ताम्राक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, having eyes red
with anger.
—रोष-परीत, अस्, आ, अम्, filled with
wrath.
—रोष-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of anger,
proceeding from fury.
—रोष-वाहण, अस्, आ, अम्,
‘being a vehicle of anger,’ bearing or feeling wrath
(= आरूढ-क्रोध).
—रोषाक्षेप (˚ष-आक्˚),
अस्, m. (in rhetoric) angry expression of dissent, angry
reproach, ironical taunt.
—रोषावरोह (˚ष-अव्˚),
अस्, m., N. of a warrior on the side of the gods in
the war against the Asuras.

रोषण, अस्, ई, अम्, angry, wrathful, passionate,
easily enraged; enraged at or against, (क्षत्रिय-
[]
रोषण, exasperated at the Kṣatriyas); (अस्), m. a
touch-stone; quicksilver; an arid or desert soil con-
taining salt; Grewia Asiatica.
—रोषण-ता, f. the
state of being easily enraged, proneness to anger,
irritability, wrath.
रोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, exasperated, irritated.
रोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, angry, wrathful, irritable, furious.

रोष्टृ, टा, टॄ, an injurer; one who is vexed
or angry, wrathful.
